legend: At the opening of the olympiad, each participant was given a pen and a notepad. Since, due to budget "optimization", it was not possible to buy any other prizes, so the jury decided to award each awardee with another a$$$a$$$ pens and b$$$b$$$ notepads, and each winner — with 2a$$$2a$$$ pens and 2b$$$2b$$$ notepads.
Determine the minimum possible number of people who could have participated in the olympiad, if in total c$$$c$$$ pens and d$$$d$$$ notepads were distributed.
Explanation: the sets of awardees and winners do not intersect.
input: The input data contain four integers a$$$a$$$, b$$$b$$$, c$$$c$$$, and d$$$d$$$ (1≤a,b,c,d≤1018$$$1 \le a, b, c, d \le 10^{18}$$$), each integer on a separate line.
output: Print one integer — the minimum possible number of participants. If there is no solution, print 0.
note: In the first example, among 6 participants there were either zero winners and two awardees, or one winner and zero awardees.

legend.ai: 在奥林匹克竞赛开幕式上，每位参赛者都获得了一支钢笔和一个笔记本。由于预算“优化”，无法购买其他任何奖品，所以评委会决定给每位获奖者再发放 a$$$a$$$ 支钢笔和 b$$$b$$$ 个笔记本，给每位优胜者发放 2a$$$2a$$$ 支钢笔和 2b$$$2b$$$ 个笔记本。
已知总共分发了 c$$$c$$$ 支钢笔和 d$$$d$$$ 个笔记本，求可能参加奥林匹克竞赛的最少人数。
解释：获奖者与获胜者的集合不相交。

output.ai: 输出一个整数——可能的最少参与者人数。如果不存在解，输出 0。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，6 名参与者中要么有 0 名获胜者和 2 名获奖者，要么有 1 名获胜者和 0 名获奖者。
